name: scene-strip
title: Scene Strip
description: A row of the scenes or chapters of a clip, each with a picture, a name and a length, that scrolls sideways, marks the one that is playing and goes to a scene when it is pressed.

meta.when: Under or beside a player whose clip has named parts: chapters of a lesson, scenes of a film, steps of a recipe. It reads the time from the player it is inside (wrap the player and the strip in VideoPlayerProvider, or put it inside AudioPlayer), or from `time` and `onSeek`. For marks on the time bar itself use the scrubber's `marks`; for the spoken lines use Transcript.
